hero.heading: Admissions
hero.subheading: Begin your journey toward transformative theological and music education

intake: Academic year begins in June. Applications are accepted from January through April.

process.title: Submit Application
process.desc: Complete the online application form and submit all required documents.

process.title: Document Review
process.desc: Our admissions team reviews your application, transcripts, and reference letters.

process.title: Personal Interview
process.desc: Selected applicants are invited for a personal interview with faculty.

process.title: Admission Decision
process.desc: You will receive a written offer of admission within 2–3 weeks of your interview.

process.title: Enrollment
process.desc: Accept your offer, pay the registration fee, and complete enrollment formalities.

general: Copies of academic certificates and mark sheets
requirements.programSpecific: Each program may have additional requirements. Please refer to the individual course pages for details.

fees.note: Detailed fee structure is provided upon admission offer. Scholarships and payment plans are available.

faq.question: When can I apply?
faq.answer: Applications are open from January 1 to April 30 each year for the June intake. Late applications may be considered subject to availability.

faq.question: Are scholarships available?
faq.answer: Yes, GEC offers merit-based and need-based scholarships. Contact admissions for details and eligibility criteria.

faq.question: Can international students apply?
faq.answer: Yes, GEC welcomes applications from international students. Please contact us to discuss visa requirements and specific arrangements.

faq.question: Is there a hostel facility?
faq.answer: Yes, GEC provides separate hostel accommodations for male and female students. Accommodation is subject to availability.

faq.question: What documents do I need for admission?
faq.answer: Generally: academic transcripts, pastoral recommendation, personal statement, and government ID. Program-specific requirements may apply.

faq.question: How do I know if my application was received?
faq.answer: You will receive an email acknowledgment within 2 business days of submitting your application.
